snippet.title: Ghost Cam - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Explore eerie liminal spaces, capture spirits before they find you, and unravel a haunting horse girl mystery in the spooky VR game Ghost Cam. Your camcorder will help you see what your eyes can't as you conduct an investigation into the paranormal – and try to capture poltergeists before they catch you. Get a fresh look at Ghost Cam in this latest trailer ahead of the game's launch on Meta Quest and Steam.
